summary.text: Al Cutrona, listed by Ballotpedia as Alessandro Cutrona, is a Republican state senator from Ohio who has represented District 33 since June 2024 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he previously served in the Ohio House from 2020 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Alessandro Cutrona is an attorney who worked as chief operating officer and in-house counsel of Northeast Ohio Infectious Disease Associates in Youngstown at the time of his appointment to the Senate.
He received a bachelor's degree in political science and history from Youngstown State University and a J.D. from Case Western Reserve University School of Law.
Cutrona served in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2020 to 2024, including as vice chair of the Families, Aging, and Human Services Committee in 2021–2022.
On June 13, 2024, the Republican Party chairs of Mahoning, Columbiana and Carroll counties appointed him to the Ohio Senate to replace Michael Rulli, and he assumed office on June 26, 2024.
He advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Michael Kripchak in the general election.
